item.title: Stock Android vs manufacturer skins: What’s the real difference?
item.description: Ask anyone what “stock Android” is and their answer would likely be that it’s a clean mobile interface without bloatware or imposed design changes. That simplicity explains why it appeals to so many users – as a concept, at least. In reality, most Android phones don’t run software like this. Not exactly.
